items.a: AI README Generator is a web-based application that automatically creates professional README.md files for your GitHub repositories using artificial intelligence (Gemini AI).
Yes, this application is free to use. It was developed as part of an Undergraduate Thesis research.
This application was developed by a student for Undergraduate Thesis research in the field of software engineering and artificial intelligence.

1. Enter your GitHub repository URL.
2. Choose your project purpose (Portfolio, Academic, or Open Source).
3. Open Pro Mode for further customization (optional).
4. Click the Generate button and wait for the result.
Yes, currently the application only supports public repositories. Private repositories cannot be accessed.

items.q: 6. Why does the generate process take so long?
items.a: The system needs to fetch all repository data (config files, directory structure, etc.) from GitHub first, then process it with Gemini AI. Time varies depending on the repository size.

items.q: 7. Can the generated README be edited?
items.a: Yes! You can use the Edit mode on the results page to modify content before copying or downloading it.
No. As a generative AI, Gemini can make technical errors (hallucinations). We strongly recommend users always review and edit the generated README before publishing.

items.q: 9. Why do I get a 'Too Many Requests' error?
items.a: This application relies on API quotas (GitHub & Google Gemini). If the hourly quota is exhausted, the system will temporarily reject requests. Please try again later.

items.q: 10. What data is taken from my repository?
items.a: The system only reads public metadata from the repository, such as project name, description, directory structure, and configuration files. No source code is permanently stored.
No. Repository data is processed temporarily (in-memory) or in server memory only for README generation purposes, and is not stored in any database.

Frontend: React (TypeScript) + Vite + Tailwind CSS
Backend: Python (FastAPI)
AI: Google Gemini API (model 2.5-flash)
Method: Structural Contextualization

privacy.title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
privacy.desc: The AI README Generator application is committed to protecting user privacy. The repository URL data and preferences you enter are used exclusively for the purpose of GitHub API data analysis and processing by Google Gemini API.
points: No Cookies: We do not use tracking cookies.
No Storage: We do not store repository data or generated results in our database.
Secret Security: All API Keys (Gemini/GitHub) are securely stored on the server-side (Backend) and never exposed to the public or user's browser.
Third Party: Data usage is subject to third-party privacy policies (GitHub & Google).
